A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same A0 study. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–G are readable and support direct comparison. V5's additional final page contains bibliography continuation.

before.justification: V4 reports original offline waypoint-prediction experiments, architecture ablations and real-robot success rates in Section 5, plus a RoboPoint comparison and qualitative demonstrations in the appendices.

after.justification: V5 retains these original empirical results, including Figure 4, Tables 1–4 and the supplementary robot demonstrations.

M1.justification: Sections 3–4 retain the same affordance representation, diffusion architecture, Position Offset Attention, Spatial Information Aggregation Layer, training losses and action-execution pipeline. Appendix B's use of VLM planning was already present in v4.

E1.justification: Both use PixMo-One-Point, HOI4D-22k, DROID-3k and ManiSkill-5k, with the same robot tasks and supplementary demonstrations. Newly cited benchmarks and applications in Section 2.2 are not added evaluations.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains MOKA, ReKep and RDT on Kinova, and Magma and Molmo on Franka. Table 3 retains RDT-1B, pi0 and pi0 + FAST; Appendix D/Table 4 retains RoboPoint. Citation renumbering does not change comparator membership.

E3.justification: Both retain the 8:2 dataset splits, 3,600-image PixMo test set, MAE evaluation, 1B model with five waypoints, and 80,000-step pretraining and 30,000-step fine-tuning settings. The real-robot and Appendix D comparison procedures also match.

E4.justification: Figure 4 retains the same pretraining and real-to-simulation/simulation-to-real analyses, and Table 1 retains the POA and SIAL ablations. The planning examples and background-generalization demonstrations in the appendices are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both specify 20 trials per real-robot task. V5 adds no run or seed counts, uncertainty summaries, confidence intervals or statistical tests, and the existing reporting practices remain unchanged.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–4 and Figure 4 match, as do the qualitative demonstrations and findings. For example, Table 2 retains A0's average success rates of 53.75% on Kinova and 62.50% on Franka; Table 4 retains its MAEs of 54.46 and 14.13.

T1.justification: Equations 1–8 retain the same representation definitions, diffusion formulation, losses, geometric projection, grasp selection and MAE definition. No mathematical assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introductory contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about object-centric affordances, hierarchical diffusion, cross-platform generalization and manipulation performance. The related-work edits do not redefine A0's contributions.

C2.justification: The interpretations of pretraining, architecture ablations and comparative performance are unchanged. Appendix B retains the same grasp-estimation, depth/occlusion, orientation-sensitive and long-horizon limitations and proposed remedies.

D1.justification: The model settings, four A100 80GB GPUs, batch size, training times and memory requirements are unchanged. Appendices C and F retain the annotation procedures and data-processing details; the project address and planned dataset-release statement also remain the same.

R1.justification: Section 2.2 adds five references: a robot-vision survey, Phyblock, 3d-more, Navid and Robridge, while broadening one phrase from robotic manipulation to robotic tasks. All 60 earlier bibliography entries remain. The introduction removes an unresolved ATM citation, but ATM remains cited in Appendix B.2.

P1.justification: V5 adds a Project Leader footnote for Rongtao Xu, changes Yuxuan Kuang's affiliation to CMU and abbreviates two institution names. The introduction and Section 2.2 receive limited edits; the section organization and remaining exposition are retained.

P2.justification: The added first-page footnote shifts introductory text, and the expanded bibliography reflows onto another page. Figures 1–12 and Tables 1–4 retain their graphical content, display structure and placement within the paper.

improvement.justification: V5 removes an unresolved introductory citation and updates author information and background references. This offers a small editorial benefit, but the added citations receive no substantive comparative discussion, and the methods, evidence, technical explanations and limitations remain unchanged. The revision does not meaningfully alter the paper's overall quality.
